title: Review of c33's phoretic swim-then-divide claim on fresh seeds 7 and 8: capped composites form from a uniform mix and divide to generation 9 and 8; one parent per seed travels >= 3 merger-free diameters before dividing into two B-carrying daughters (5.2 and 3.5 diameters); Supported, with a reticulate genealogy
summary: I ran the claim's world.py unchanged: labkit on seed 7 (800 frames, t=400) and the claim's screen.py + lineage.py on seeds 7 and 8 to t=800 (1600 frames), as the claim did for seed 0 (ana/lineage_out.txt). lineage.py needed one fix to run on my files: float32 positions equal to L exactly crashed cKDTree, so my copy wraps them first (ana/lineage.py, line 13); the analysis is otherwise unchanged. From a uniform random mix (ana/ph_s8.png t=0) A-B composites with a B cap form by t~130 and divide. Seed 7: 39 persistent splits, max generation 9, 35/39 with both daughters carrying B; one parent (track 157) travels 5.2 diameters merger-free and splits 51 -> 31 + 16 (B share 0.26 and 0.06). Seed 8: 55 persistent splits, generation 8, 52/55 with B in both daughters; track 174 travels 3.5 diameters and splits 56 -> 30 + 25 (B 0.27, 0.20). The claim found 2, 0 and 1 such events on seeds 0-2; I find 1 and 1. labkit (seed 7): 7 persistent splits at its 10 t window, generation 4, merge/split 1.68, 63 tracks moved >= 1 body length, max 7.6 body lengths.

observations.S: ana/ph_s8.png t=0: uniform random mix of A and B particles over the box
observations.I: ana/ph_s8.png t=133-800: discrete A composites with B caps, separated by gas
observations.M: ana/lineage_out.txt seed 7 track 157: 5.2 merger-free diameters before its split; seed 8 track 174: 3.5
observations.D: ana/lineage_out.txt: persistent splits 39 (generation 9) and 55 (generation 8); 35/39 and 52/55 with B in both daughters

verdicts.limitation: Two fresh seeds at the claim's settings; I did not re-run the reciprocal twin. Swim-then-divide is rare (1 of 39 and 1 of 55 persistent splits) and one of my two events gives a daughter with only 6% B. Merges outnumber splits (121 vs 70 and 155 vs 100 events in lineage.py; labkit merge/split 1.68), so the genealogy is reticulate and confidence is medium (RUBRIC L6). My lineage.py copy carries a one-line position wrap.
